answer_1.quote: Feedback comment generation is the task of generating explanatory notes for writing learning ...

answer_2.quote: We measured performance by accuracy. We defined accuracy by the number of appropriate generation results divided by the total number of generation results, which will be referred to as a STRICT setting.

answer_4.quote: A professional annotator, who had English teaching experience for three years, manually evaluated the results. The annotator labeled each generated feedback comment as appropriate, partially appropriate, or inappropriate.
answer_4.guideline: Two conditions were used: (1) the type of error is correctly identified, and (2) replacing a few words makes it appropriate.
